Abbasia Campus
A Historical building was initially constructed by His Highness Nawab Sir Sadiq Muhammad Khan Abbasi – V in the heart of the city near Government Sadiq Egerton College at University Chowk, Bahawalpur, to impart higher education in 1950. Currently this campus maintains Vice Chancellor’s Secretariat, Ghulam Muhammad Ghotvi Hall (a historical hall), Faculty of Law, Banks, Admission Cell, Registrar Office, Legal Cell, Examination Division, Accounts Division, Directorate of Outreach, Communications and Public Relations, two students’ hostels; Abu Bakar Hall for Boys and Rabia Hall for Girls, Two Mosques, Medical and Health Division, Transport Division and Transport Division, Sports Ground and University Guest House. The University Central Camp House is also located at nearby University Road.

Baghdad-ul-Jadeed Campus
Baghdad-ul-Jadeed Campus (BJC), also known as Main Campus or BJ Campus, is located at Hasilpur Road, about eight kilometers from the city center. Ten out of thirteen faculties are established at BJ Campus. The campus is covered with proper security wall and also maintains a Vice Chancellor’s Secretariat, Cricket Ground, Sports Complex, Squash Court, Separate Study Parks for Boys and Girls, Football Ground, Libraries, E-Rozgar Training Center, Computer Labs, Faculty Auditoriums, Main Auditorium, Local Market, Grand Jamia Masjid, Medical Center, Employees Residential Colony, Day Care Center, Student Hostels, Deer Breeding Farm, Research/Experimental Areas, Hakra Art Gallery, Plants Nursery, Solar Park, Cut Flower and Fresh Vegetables Farms, Fruits Farms, Fish Pond with Boating Facility, Cafeterias, Bank, Water Filtration Plants, un-interrupted Electricity Supply, availability of all Mobile Networks, Carpeted Roads, Clean and Green Environment and orchards make the atmosphere congenial for academic activities.
Other major buildings on the campus include the Cholistan Institute of Desert Studies, Directorate of Information and Technology, Faculty of Agriculture, Faculty of Arts, Faculty of Engineering and Technology, Faculty of Islamic Learning, Faculty of Science, Faculty of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Institute of Business Management and Administrative Sciences, University Model School, and Syed Tabish Alwari Administrative Block.

These programs are categorized across various groups (A, B, and 5th semester entry) to cater to different entry requirements and educational backgrounds.
Undergraduate Programs (4-Year Duration, Typically Group A & B Entry):
Core Commerce and Accounting:
B.Com (Hons): Offered to both Group A and Group B entrants, providing a foundational and detailed understanding of commerce principles, including accounting, finance, and economics.
BS Accounting & Finance: Available for Group A and Group B, focusing on rigorous training in financial reporting, corporate finance, auditing, and investment analysis.
Specialized Financial Disciplines:
BS Banking and Finance: (Group A) Concentrates on the operations, regulations, and challenges within the banking and broader financial services sector.
BS FinTech (Financial Technologies): (Group A) A forward-looking program addressing the intersection of technology and finance, including digital payments, blockchain, and algorithmic trading.
BS Finance and Investment: (Group A) Delves into the principles of investment management, portfolio theory, financial markets, and corporate financial strategy.
General Business Administration (BBA) and Management:
BBA (Hons) After 12 Years Education: Offered to Group A and Group B, providing a broad-based education in core business functions like marketing, human resources, operations, and strategy.
BS Administrative & Management Sciences: (Group A) Focuses on the theoretical and practical aspects of organizational management, public administration, and decision-making processes.
BS Leadership & Management: (Group A) Specifically designed to cultivate essential leadership qualities and advanced management skills necessary for senior organizational roles.
Market-Centric and Entrepreneurial Programs:
BS E-Commerce: (Group A) Covers the development, implementation, and management of online businesses, including digital strategy, payment systems, and e-business models.
BS Supply Chain Management: (Group A) Focuses on the efficient flow of goods, services, and information, covering logistics, procurement, and operations management.
BS Digital Marketing: (Group A) Provides specialized knowledge in contemporary marketing techniques utilizing digital platforms, search engine optimization (SEO), social media, and data analytics.
BS Digital Entrepreneurship & Business Management: (Group A) Merges the principles of starting a new venture with the specific tools and strategies required in the digital economy.
BS in Entrepreneurship and Business Innovation (After 12 Years of Education): (Group A & B) Cultivates an entrepreneurial mindset, focusing on idea generation, business planning, and the innovation process.
BS Marketing and International Business: (Group A) Covers domestic marketing strategies alongside the complexities and opportunities of global trade and international market entry.
BS HRM (Human Resource Management): (Group A) Specializes in managing an organization's most valuable asset, covering areas like recruitment, training, compensation, and labor relations.
Sector-Specific Management:
BS Aviation Management: (Group A) Focuses on the management, operations, and regulatory framework of the aviation industry, including airlines and airport management.
BS Tourism, Hospitality and Business Management (After 12 Years Education): (Group A) A four-year program blending general business management with the specific operational requirements of the tourism and hospitality sector.
Programs for Advanced Entry (2-Year Duration, Typically 5th Semester Entry):
BBA (Hons) After 14 Years Education: (Group A & B) Provides a pathway for individuals with an Associate Degree or equivalent to complete their BBA honors degree.
BBA Technology Management: (Group A, B & 5th) A program dedicated to managing technological resources and innovation, with a specific entry point available for 5th semester students.
BS Tourism, Hospitality and Business Management (After 14 Years Education) Duration 2 Years: (5th) Caters to students with prior relevant qualifications, allowing them to complete the specialization in two years.
These programs reflect the Faculty's commitment to offering specialized and relevant degrees that meet the evolving demands of local and international job markets. The different grouping (A, B, 5th) signifies varying admission criteria, primarily based on the preceding level of education.

The Faculty of Agriculture & Environment offers a comprehensive suite of programs designed to equip students with the knowledge and skills necessary to address modern challenges in agricultural productivity, environmental sustainability, and related technological fields.
Undergraduate Programs (Bachelor of Science/Science Hons):
BSc. (Hons) Agriculture: This flagship program is offered in two distinct specializations, Group A and Group B, to allow for focused study in various agricultural disciplines, encompassing crop science, animal husbandry, soil science, and agricultural economics.
BS Forestry: Also offered under both Group A and Group B, this program focuses on the management, conservation, and sustainable utilization of forest resources, addressing ecological principles and forest economics.
BS Food Science and Technology: Available in Group A and Group B, this degree covers the scientific principles of food processing, preservation, quality control, and the development of new food products, ensuring safety and nutritional value from farm to table.
BS Environmental Science: Offered under Group A, this program provides a deep understanding of environmental issues, focusing on pollution control, natural resource management, ecological restoration, and environmental policy.
BS Agri. Business: This Group A program integrates agricultural knowledge with core business principles, preparing students for managerial and entrepreneurial roles in the diverse agricultural supply chain, including marketing, finance, and supply chain management.
BS Artificial Intelligence & Climate Change: A forward-looking program under Group A that explores the application of Artificial Intelligence and advanced data analytics to model, mitigate, and adapt to the impacts of climate change on agricultural and environmental systems.
Diploma Program:
Diploma in Agriculture Science (DAS): This specialized diploma is a structured 3-Year / 6 Semester program designed to provide practical, hands-on training and foundational knowledge in key areas of agricultural practice, preparing graduates for technical roles and further professional development in the sector.
This faculty is a hub for linguistic, historical, and cultural studies. It offers foundational and specialized programs such as:
English Studies: BS English Language & Literature and BS English Language & Linguistics, both available across multiple groups (A, B, & 5th). A specialized Diploma in TEFL (One Year Program) is also offered (Group A).
Historical and Area Studies: BS History, BS Pakistan Studies (both A, B & 5th), BS Archeology, BS Iqbal Studies, and BS Philosophy (all Group A & 5th/A).
Regional and Foreign Languages: BS Persian, BS Saraiki, and BS Urdu (Group A, B & 5th/A).
Creative Arts: A demanding Bachelor in Fine Arts & Bachelor in Design is offered as a 4-Years Program (Group A, 5th Offering in Fine Arts Majors). This program provides conditional specializations in Painting, Printmaking, Sculpture, Miniature Painting, Visual Communication Design, Textile Design, Fashion Design, and Interior Design.
Faculty of Social Sciences
Focusing on the study of human behavior, society, and policy, this faculty presents a wide-ranging curriculum:
Psychology and Economics: BS Applied Psychology (A, B & 5th), and a variety of economics programs including BS Economics & Finance, BS Economics (A & 5th), BS Economics with IT, and BS Business Economics (all Group A).
Development and Security Studies: BS Development Studies, BS Defence and Diplomatic Studies (both Group A).
Media and Information Science: BS Mass Communication, BS Information Management (Library and Information Science) (both A, B & 5th).
Political Science and Governance: BS International Relations, BS Political Science (A, B & 5th), BS Politics & Parliamentary Studies, BS Public Policy and Governance, BS Public Administration (A, B & 5th).
Sociology and Social Welfare: BS Social Work (A, B & 5th), BS Anthropology (A & 5th), and BS Sociology (A, B & 5th).
Specialized Programs: BS Gender Studies (Group A) and a Diploma Course in Gender Studies (6 months program).
Faculty of Chemical & Biological Sciences
This faculty provides rigorous training in fundamental life and chemical sciences:
Biological Sciences: BS Botany, BS Zoology, BS Biochemistry, BS Biotechnology (all A, B & 5th), and BS Bioinformatics (Group A).
Chemical Sciences: BS Chemistry (A, B & 5th).
Faculty of Veterinary & Animal Sciences
Dedicated to animal health and livestock management, the programs include:
BS Animal Sciences (Group A & B), BS Applied Microbiology (Group A & B), BS Physiology (Group A & B), BS Poultry Science (Group A), and BS Genetics (Group A).
Vocational Program: A Livestock Assistant Diploma (2-Years) is also available (Group B).
Faculty of Physical & Mathematical Sciences
Covering the principles of the physical universe and abstract mathematics:
BS Mathematics, BS Physics (both A, B & 5th).
Earth Sciences: BS Geography and BS Remote Sensing & GIS (both Group A).
Faculty of Medicine & Allied Health Sciences
This faculty offers health-related programs focusing on public health and alternative medicine:
Core Health Science: BS Public Health (Group A & 5th) and BS Forensic Science (Group B).
Specialized Diplomas: A Diploma in Cupping Therapy (Hijama) and various Postgraduate Diplomas in Acupuncture & Pain Management, Aesthetic Health Sciences, and Alternative Medicine & Health Product Manufacturing (APM).
Faculty of Education
A comprehensive set of programs is offered to train educators across all levels:
Undergraduate Education: BS Education, BS Secondary Education, BS Elementary Education, BS Educational Leadership & Management (all A, B & 5th/A).
Various B.Ed. programs: B.Ed 04 years (After FA/FSc), B.Ed. 2.5 Years (After BA/BSc/ADE), B.Ed. 1.5 Years (After MA/MSc/BS), and B.Ed. 1.5 years Special Education Years (all A & B/A).
BEd Science Tracks: BEd Science (4-years) after FSc, BEd Science (2-years) after 4 semester of BS or Bsc, and BEd Science (1.5-years) after BS Science or MSc (all A/A & B).
Graduate Education: M.Ed. (After B.Ed/BS Ed) (Group B).
Specialized Education: BS Physical Education & Sports Sciences, BS Special Education (both A, B & 5th), BS English Language Teaching (A & 5th), and BS Early Childhood Education (Group-A).
Faculty of Islamic and Arabic Studies
Dedicated to Islamic and Arabic learning, with programs including:
BS Arabic (A & 5th), BS Islamic Studies (Group A), BS Translation and Interpretation (A, B & 5th).
Specialized Islamic Studies Tracks (all Group A): BS Islamic Studies with Specialization in Hadith Studies, Quranic Studies, Fiqah & Sharia, and World Religions & Interfaith Harmony.
Faculty of Engineering & Technology
Focusing on cutting-edge technological fields:
BS Cyber Security and Digital Forensic (Group A).
BS Intelligent Systems and Robotics (Group A).
Faculty of Computing
A broad and modern spectrum of computing and information technology programs:
Core Computing: BS Computer Science (Group A & B), BS Information Technology (A, B & 5th), BS Software Engineering (Group A & B).
Specialized Fields: BS Information Systems, BS Multimedia and Gaming (Group A), BSCS (specialization in network and communication) (A).
Emerging Technologies: BS Artificial Intelligence (A & B & 5th), BS Cyber Security, BS Internet of Things, BS Data Sciences (all A/A & B & 5th).
Statistical Analysis: BS Statistics (Group A & B) and BS Biostatistics (Group A).

Humanities, Languages, and Social Sciences
Admissions for these programs are offered through the initial merit lists (Group-A and Group-B) and extended up to the 5th merit list. BS Economics is a comprehensive four-year program focusing on economic theory, policy analysis, and quantitative methods, preparing students for careers in finance, research, and public service. BS English Language & Linguistics focuses on the structure, history, and social context of the English language, including phonetics, syntax, semantics, and sociolinguistics. BS English Language & Literature combines the study of major literary works in English with an in-depth analysis of linguistic principles and language teaching methodologies. BS Urdu is a four-year degree dedicated to the study of Urdu literature, poetry, grammar, and its historical and cultural evolution. BS Applied Psychology explores the application of psychological principles to real-world problems in areas such as clinical, organizational, and educational settings. BS Pakistan Studies is an interdisciplinary program covering the history, politics, geography, culture, and socio-economic dynamics of Pakistan. BS Islamic Studies involves an in-depth study of the Quran, Hadith, Islamic jurisprudence (Fiqh), history, and philosophy, fostering a comprehensive understanding of Islamic principles.
Education and Pedagogical Sciences
BS Education is a four-year program offering a foundation in educational theories, instructional design, assessment, and pedagogical techniques (Group-A, B & 5th). B.Ed 4-Years (after FA/F.Sc) is an intensive four-year teacher training program designed for students who have completed Intermediate (Group-A & B). B.Ed 2.5-Years (after BA/B.Sc/ADE) is a two-and-a-half-year program for candidates holding a Bachelor's degree or an Associate Degree in Education (Group-A & B). B.Ed 1.5-Years (after MA/M.Sc/BS) is a one-and-a-half-year professional qualification for graduates with a Master's or a four-year BS degree, aiming to enter the teaching profession (Group-A & B). M.Ed (after B.Ed / BS Ed) is an advanced degree focusing on educational leadership, curriculum development, research methods, and specialized pedagogical practices (Group-A & B). BS Physical Education & Sports Sciences combines the study of human anatomy, physiology, nutrition, and exercise science with sports management and coaching techniques (A, B & 5th).
Computer Science and Information Technology
BS Computer Science is a rigorous program covering fundamental concepts of computing, algorithm design, software development, and theoretical computer science (Group-A, B & 5th). BS Information Technology focuses on the management, storage, transmission, and security of information, emphasizing network infrastructure and system administration (Group-A, B & 5th). BS Cyber Security is a specialized program dedicated to protecting computer systems, networks, and data from digital attacks, focusing on ethical hacking, forensics, and security protocols (Group-A, B & 5th). BS Software Engineering teaches the systematic approach to designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software systems, adhering to engineering principles (Group-A, B & 5th).
Business, Management, and Commerce
BBA (Hons) after 12-years of Education is a four-year honors program providing a broad understanding of business functions, including marketing, finance, human resources, and operations management (Group-A, B & 5th). BS Public Administration prepares students for careers in government and non-profit organizations, focusing on policy implementation, public finance, and organizational management (Group-A, B & 5th). BS Commerce covers essential aspects of business, accounting, banking, finance, and trade, providing a strong foundation for professional accounting and financial roles (Group-A, B & 5th).
Natural and Life Sciences
BS Botany is dedicated to the scientific study of plant life, including plant structure, function, ecology, genetics, and economic importance (Group-A, B & 5th). BS Physics explores the fundamental principles governing matter, energy, space, and time, with a focus on theoretical and experimental physics (Group-A, B & 5th). BS Mathematics is a rigorous program covering pure and applied mathematics, including calculus, algebra, topology, and differential equations (Group-A, B & 5th). BS Biotechnology involves the use of living systems and organisms to develop or make products, particularly in medicine, agriculture, and industry (Group-A, B & 5th). BS Biochemistry is the study of chemical processes within and relating to living organisms, essential for understanding molecular biology, genetics, and medicine (Group-A, B & 5th). BS Zoology is the scientific study of animals, covering anatomy, physiology, genetics, ecology, and evolution of diverse fauna (Group-A, B & 5th). BS Chemistry is a core science program exploring the composition, structure, properties, and reactions of matter (Group-A, B & 5th).

Liaquatpur Sub Campus
Welcome to Liaquatpur Sub Campus, the Islamia University of Bahawalpur. It is an honor for me to lead at this campus of IUB. We strongly believe that students are the valuable assets of any academic institution, especially universities across the globe. At the Liaquatpur Campus, we strive to be an institution for excellence in providing education. To achieve this goal we provide a healthy environment of education that is quality embedded, focused, and innovative. We also help our students to discover their potential by grooming them to be intellectually mature, self-esteemed, socially aware, and ethically enlightened for fulfilling the demands of the educational, industrial, and financial sectors. To achieve these goals, we have engaged highly qualified and dedicated faculty who are well aware of the emerging trends and future market needs. I am sure that being a student at this institution you will experience the best days of your academic life, and we promise to ensure that you are well prepared for your future endeavors.

The BBA (after 12-years of Education) is uniquely offered under both Group-A and Group-B, providing both Standard Entry and 5th Semester Entry points.
Computer Science and Information Technology
Technical programs show high availability across both admission groups. BS Computer Science, BS Information Technology, and BS Software Engineering are all offered under Group-A and Group-B with both Standard Entry and 5th Semester Entry options. BS Information Security is also available under Group-A and Group-B but for Standard Entry only. Specialized programs like BS Artificial Intelligence (offered under Group-A for Standard and 5th Semester Entry) and BS Cyber Security (offered under Group-A for Standard Entry) round out the technology offerings.
Humanities, Languages, and Social Sciences
All programs in this category are offered under Group-A and provide both Standard Entry and 5th Semester Entry. These include BS English Language & Linguistics, BS English Language & Literature, BS Urdu, BS Applied Psychology, BS Pakistan Studies, and BS Islamic Studies.
Education Programs
The education department features various entry levels. BS Education is offered under Group-A for both Standard and 5th Semester Entry. The B.Ed 4-Years (after FA/F.Sc) and B.Ed 2.5-Years (after BA/B.Sc/ADE) are offered under Group-A for Standard Entry. The B.Ed 1.5-Years (after MA/M.Sc/BS) is available under both Group-A and Group-B for Standard Entry. Additionally, the M.Ed (after B.Ed / BS Ed) is offered under Group-A for Standard Entry at the Master Level.
Physical and Biological Sciences
The science faculty provides extensive options, mostly under Group-A. Programs offering both Standard and 5th Semester Entry under Group-A include BS Botany, BS Mathematics, BS Biotechnology, BS Biochemistry, BS Zoology, BS Chemistry, BS Statistics, and BS Physical Education & Sports Sciences. Notably, BS Physics is offered under both Group-A and Group-B for Standard and 5th Semester Entry. Finally, BS Applied Microbiology and BS Human Nutrition and Dietetics are offered exclusively under Group-B for Standard Entry only.
